Method: owner chose options in a recorder question

Decisions.Question: which machine is the formal validation host
Decisions.Choice: this desktop + a separate standard (non-admin) local account used only for validation
Decisions.ChoiceLabel: 本机+独立普通账户（推荐）

Decisions.Question: enable Windows process-creation auditing (4688 with command line) on the validation host
Decisions.Choice: allowed; owner performs the change; may be turned off afterwards

Decisions.Question: reviewer outside the recorder's model family
Decisions.Choice: Codex, routed through the owner's existing coordination process

ExecutionNotes: the recorder does not create accounts, set passwords or change security settings; the owner performs those steps
until executed and recorded, nothing changes on the machine
